residents.source_title: Carnegie Mellon Annual Security and Fire Safety Report housing census (2024 edition)
residents.scope_note: Pittsburgh undergraduates: University Housing 3,158 plus separately listed Fraternity & Sorority Housing 300. These disjoint rows are actual student classifications in the fall census. Current CMU Housing office explicitly states on-campus housing is unavailable to graduate students. ASR definition includes fraternity/sorority houses in residential facilities; the source discusses the on-campus fraternity/sorority quad. University-managed off-campus housing and branch footprints are not independently parcel-matched. Other ASR branches show housing not applicable; this is a qualified institutional housing proxy, not an annual mean. The fall 2024 housing table labels its population as Pittsburgh, but its total equals the university-wide undergraduate enrollment across locations. That scope discrepancy remains unresolved. Fall 2025 housing cells are blank.
